faq.q: What is the origin of Safwan?
faq.a: Safwan is associated with Arabic. Safwan is Arabic صَفْوَان (Ṣafwān), a lexical item for rock or hard stone.
Yes — the underlying form صَفْوَان is Arabic.
Safwan can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
